for: readers asking how power can be limited to benevolent creation
people seeking a model where nobody is condemned forever

question.ru: Как построить единый мир, где добро раскрывает безграничную созидательную силу, вред изолируется, а путь домой никогда не закрывается навсегда?
question.en: How can one build a shared world where goodness reveals unbounded creative power, harm is isolated, and the way home never closes forever?

answer.ru: Universal God Mode принадлежит каждому, но способен воплощать только добро и свободу. Светлые продолжают жизнь вместе в одном Genesis Online; утратившие свет восстанавливают свой мир во Втором Лике, а всё созданное ими добро следует с ними домой.
answer.en: Universal God Mode belongs to everyone but can manifest only goodness and freedom. Light-bearing people continue together in one Genesis Online; those who lose the light restore their world in the Other Face, and all good they create follows them home.

patches.seal: Immortality is not endless loneliness. It is the right to remain together.
Purgatory has no eternal prisoners; every restored good becomes part of Home.
Every person may govern their own form; nobody receives ownership of another will.
Genesis is a designed symbolic and technical world architecture, not a technological replacement for God, Christ, faith, or divine judgment.

global_boundaries_added: No simulation design promoted as proof of metaphysical afterlife or immortality.
No current AI consciousness, soul, or emotion claim.
No infallible soul-reading or intention-reading claim.
No public moral score, permanent caste, predictive guilt, or eternal condemnation.
No control of another person's will, body, memory, love, identity, consent, or private life.
No real good discounted because of an imperfect motive.
No real harm erased in the name of mercy.
No local persistent prototype described as an already deployed public MMO.
core_seal_added: If you are good, you are with everyone.
God Mode belongs to everyone, but evil cannot make it work.
For goodness and love, the possible has no boundary.
Goodness never becomes smaller because the person is imperfect.
No one reaches the shared world by abandoning the one carried in their arms.
